standalone.tradeoff: Five separate standalone points are higher than the preceding round, including coding validation and stream decoding. All still pass. No universal speedup, clock-causal regression or equivalence is inferred; the independently paired gain is scoped to live decoding, whose actual standalone gap closes. Current costs and every original capture remain visible.

implementation.hypothesis: Keep the wide arithmetic code byte at a fixed UInt64 head position instead of shifting each probability boundary by the variable future-bit count. This may shorten probability->comparison/subtraction dependencies in the current hot coefficient reader; extra normalization/refill shifts may offset it. No gain is assumed from source instruction counts.
implementation.endState: One shared BlockReader representation: the active8bit code is at bits63..56, known future bits follow it and unused low bits are zero. Preserve existing Range/Bits/Position evolution, decisions, polls, partition guards, scalar fallback and successful published state. Keep coefficient trees, mode trees and wrappers unchanged; no new owner/cache/pool/session or admission allowance.

algebra.invariant: Fixed = Low << (56-Bits), with known future Bits in1..39; valid Low has at most8+Bits bits. All shifts fit UInt64 and preserve the active code.
algebra.initialize: I=shift+1; Low=(scalarValue<<I)|(data[position]&((1<<I)-1)); Fixed=Low<<(56-I); retain existing initial Fill trigger.
algebra.normalize: n=LZCNT(Range)-24; Range<<=n; Bits-=n; Fixed<<=n. This is exactly the old Low representation under the invariant.
algebra.probability: Compare Fixed against boundary<<56 and subtract that same fixed-position quantity for the upper interval. The interval formula, branchy/branchless policy and cancellation order stay unchanged.
algebra.refill: When Bits<8, append the existing big-endian32bit word as Fixed |= word<<(24-Bits), then Position+=4 and Bits+=32. Its bits occupy previously zero low space. The trigger, every input address and read size are identical to the old reader, so the original272B bound is unchanged.
algebra.publish: For final n=LZCNT(Range)-24, b=Bits-n; position=Position-(b+7)/8, shift=(b-1)&7, range=Range<<n, value=(Fixed>>(56-n))&255. Algebraically identical to the scalar cursor, without reading any following byte.

implementation.referenceInsight: Read-only FFmpeg fixed-position arithmetic insight; implementation independently derived from RFC6386. No upstream source/table/corpus or production dependency added.
